beats.label: S1 · Prison Planet call
beats.text: Fu appears at Beerus' planet claiming Trunks is held on his 'Prison Planet' experiment. Goku, Vegeta and Future Mai travel there to free him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Fu as the arc's architect and the mission that pulls the cast off Beerus' world.

beats.label: S1 · Xeno alliance and the barrier
beats.text: They meet Xeno Goku of the Time Patrol and learn a barrier locks them in until they gather Dragon Balls scattered on the planet.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Time Patrol Saiyans as reluctant allies and the rule that keeps the fights on-planet.

beats.label: S1 · Cumber unleashed
beats.text: Fu releases Cumber, an evil Saiyan whose aura drives Goku berserk. Golden Cooler snaps him out, and Future Mai passes over the Supreme Kai's Potara earrings.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cumber is the season's opposition and the reason the Saiyans reach for fusion; Cooler's presence sets up his later reprisal.

beats.label: S1 · Vegito vs. Golden Great Ape
beats.text: Goku and Vegeta fuse into Vegito to fight Cumber, but he becomes a Golden Great Ape; the strain defuses them without a winner.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows that even fused Blue Kaio-ken cannot close out Cumber, forcing the Xeno pair into the fight.

beats.label: S1 · Xeno Vegito breaks the shield
beats.text: Xeno Goku and Xeno Vegeta arrive as Super Saiyan 4s, fuse into Xeno Vegito, and subdue Cumber with a Kamehameha that breaks the Prison Planet's shield.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The shield's collapse is what lets the villains eventually leave; the fusion is why Cumber survives to be collected.

beats.label: S1 · Ultra Instinct returns
beats.text: Goku reawakens Ultra Instinct and finally beats Cumber. Xeno Goku teleports the others to safety, leaving Goku alone as the planet collapses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Goku's Ultra Instinct as the yardstick going forward and isolates him for the cliffhanger.

beats.label: S1 · Zamasu returns
beats.text: Five figures appear. One is Fusion Zamasu, presumed dead. They take the unconscious Cumber and vanish, stranding Goku as the planet explodes.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season was a setup for a larger conspiracy and defines every open thread of season 2.

cliffhanger.text: Fu's Prison Planet is destroyed and Goku is stranded on top of it. Fusion Zamasu, supposedly gone, has just arrived with four unknown allies and made off with Cumber.
questions: Who are the four figures standing with Zamasu?
How is Fusion Zamasu alive and one-eyed?
What does his group want with Cumber?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Reawakened Ultra Instinct in the final fight; last seen alone on the collapsing Prison Planet.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Fused with Goku as Vegito during the arc; teleported to safety by Xeno Goku.

characters.name: Future Trunks
characters.line: Freed from Fu's cell after being the bait; back with the group and unhurt.

characters.name: Future Mai
characters.line: Brought word of Trunks' capture and delivered the Supreme Kai's Potara earrings that enabled Vegito.

characters.name: Fu
characters.line: Cosmic experimenter who staged the whole arc; enraged after his lab was destroyed and still at large.

characters.name: Cumber
characters.line: The 'evil Saiyan' whose aura corrupts other Saiyans; unconscious and now in Zamasu's group's custody.

characters.name: Fusion Zamasu
characters.line: Immortal god thought destroyed; returns with an eyepatch, leading a mysterious five-strong faction.

characters.name: Xeno Goku & Xeno Vegeta
characters.line: Time Patrol counterparts from another timeline; fought as Super Saiyan 4s and Xeno Vegito before returning home.

characters.name: Cooler
characters.line: Reappeared as Golden Cooler and chased Fu through his escape portal off the Prison Planet.

beats.label: S2 · Universe 6 invaded
beats.text: Back on Beerus' planet, U6's Supreme Kai begs for help. Tuffle siblings Oren and Kamin, escapees from Fu's planet, are ravaging his universe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the multi-universe war and introduces the first two members of Hearts' gang.

beats.label: S2 · Hearts and the Universe Seed
beats.text: Their leader Hearts reveals a 'Universe Seed' and a plan to kill the Omni-King and every god. Zamasu, alive and eyepatched, stands with him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the main villain, states the season-long stakes, and confirms who was with Zamasu in the S1 cliffhanger.

beats.label: S2 · Goku returns, Universe 11 falls
beats.text: Goku returns from the Grand Minister with new control of Ultra Instinct as Hearts' gang tears through Universe 11, wounding Jiren and moving on.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Goku back in play, shows Jiren cannot solo the villains, and sets up Universe 11's later assist.

beats.label: S2 · Lagss and Meta Cooler
beats.text: A fifth villain, Lagss, emerges from a Universe Seed crystal. In Universe 3, a robotic Meta Cooler sent by Fu subdues Cumber before overheating and fleeing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Completes Hearts' roster, removes Cumber from the board, and shows Fu is still steering events from the sidelines.

beats.label: S2 · Kamioren empowered and broken
beats.text: On Earth, Oren and Kamin fuse into Kamioren, whom Hearts empowers with the Universe Seed. Goku masters Ultra Instinct and shatters them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes what the Universe Seed can do and why Hearts will turn it on himself next.

beats.label: S2 · Godslayer Hearts erases Zamasu
beats.text: Hearts absorbs the Seed himself and gains godslayer power. When Zamasu tries to resume his war on mortals, Hearts obliterates him without effort.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Zamasu thread from S1, defines Hearts' end-form, and sets the ceiling Gogeta must clear.

beats.label: S2 · Gogeta finishes Hearts, Fu waits
beats.text: Goku and Vegeta fuse into Gogeta and, with Jiren and Hit, break Hearts' meteor and kill him. Elsewhere, Fu smiles and readies his next experiment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the visible arc but explicitly hands the story to Fu, who is the actual continuing thread.

cliffhanger.text: Hearts is dead and his gang is scattered, but the true architect of everything since the Prison Planet, Fu, watches from a hidden lab and declares that his next experiment is about to begin.
questions: Why has he been orchestrating these universe-spanning battles?
Which universe or fighter is his next target?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Mastered Ultra Instinct in the fight with Kamioren and fused with Vegeta as Gogeta to finish Hearts.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Reached his evolved Super Saiyan Blue in Universe 11; fused with Goku via the Fusion Dance into Gogeta.

characters.name: Future Trunks
characters.line: Fought alongside the Saiyans throughout the invasion; back on Earth after Hearts' defeat.

characters.name: Fu
characters.line: Revealed as the true hand behind both arcs; watching from a new lab and announcing his next experiment is ready.

characters.name: Hearts
characters.line: Leader of the Core Area invaders; absorbed the Universe Seed as an 'Ultimate Godslayer' before Gogeta killed him.

characters.name: Jiren
characters.line: Universe 11's strongest, dispatched by his Supreme Kai; helped Gogeta shatter Hearts' meteor.

characters.name: Hit
characters.line: Universe 6's assassin, dispatched by his Supreme Kai; joined Jiren in the final assist on the meteor.

characters.name: Grand Minister
characters.line: Trained Goku in Ultra Instinct between arcs and observed the final battle; sensed Zamasu's death and Hearts' rise.

characters.name: Fusion Zamasu
characters.line: Rejoined Hearts to resume his purge of mortals; erased by Hearts once the Universe Seed was fully absorbed.

beats.label: S3 · Champa's wager
beats.text: Beerus's twin Champa arrives, revealing Universe Six's Earth was destroyed. He proposes a tournament; the winning universe claims the other's Earth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the entire premise: why the tournament exists and what is at stake.

beats.label: S3 · Team assembled
beats.text: Bulma builds a Super Dragon Radar to hunt the final Super Dragon Ball. Beerus's team fills out with Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Buu, and the mysterious Monaka.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the roster and plants Monaka and the Super Dragon Ball wish, both live threads.

beats.label: S3 · Written exam
beats.text: At the arena, Buu falls asleep during the written exam and is disqualified. Goku fights first, then Piccolo, Vegeta, and Monaka last.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the fight order and removes Buu, so the reader can follow who steps up next.

beats.label: S3 · Frost cheats
beats.text: Goku dispatches Botamo, then faces Frost, a beloved Universe Six hero resembling Frieza. Frost secretly drugs Goku with a hidden weapon and knocks him from the ring.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Goku is out of the tournament and Frost's true nature becomes the pivot for the next beat.

beats.label: S3 · Frost unmasked
beats.text: After Jaco exposes Frost's cheating and criminal empire, Piccolo wins by disqualification. Vegeta demands a rematch and beats Frost cleanly.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Clears Frost off the board and hands momentum to Vegeta going into his streak.

beats.label: S3 · Vegeta and Cabba
beats.text: Vegeta wins against Magetta and Cabba, a young Universe Six Saiyan, awakening the youth's Super Saiyan form by provoking him before knocking him out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Cabba as a Universe Six Saiyan Vegeta has now mentored — a bond that outlives this season.

beats.label: S3 · Hit arrives
beats.text: Universe Six's last fighter, the assassin Hit, uses a time-skip technique to floor Vegeta. Goku steps up, and both agree to fight at full power.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the exact match the next season opens on; the reader needs to know why Goku is squaring off with Hit.

cliffhanger.text: The tournament has come down to Goku versus the assassin Hit, both preparing for a final full-power showdown. If Universe Six wins, Champa takes Earth.
questions: Can Goku crack Hit's time-skip in time to win?
What are Monaka's 'true colors' that Whis keeps hinting at?
If Champa loses, will he honour the wager?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Universe Seven's lead fighter; knocked out by Frost's poison but reinstated, now facing Hit at full power.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Beat Frost, Magetta, and Cabba back-to-back before Hit's time-skip put him down; watching Goku from the sidelines.

characters.name: Hit
characters.line: The Universe Six assassin whose time-skip freezes a tenth of a second for everyone but him; the last fighter standing between Universe Seven and the win.

characters.name: Champa
characters.line: Beerus's twin and Universe Six's God of Destruction; staged the whole tournament to claim Universe Seven's Earth after his own was destroyed.

characters.name: Beerus
characters.line: Universe Seven's God of Destruction; accepted the wager and personally recruited Monaka as his hidden card.

characters.name: Cabba
characters.line: Young Universe Six Saiyan who has just awakened Super Saiyan under Vegeta's provocation, and left the ring with Vegeta's advice to surpass all others.

characters.name: Bulma
characters.line: Built the Super Dragon Radar to hunt the last ball; suspicious of what Beerus would wish for if his side wins.

characters.name: Monaka
characters.line: Beerus's mysterious final pick, held in reserve as the closer; Whis has quietly hinted his 'true colors' are not what Goku assumes.

beats.label: S4 · Black Kills Bulma
beats.text: In an alternate future, a Goku look-alike calling himself Black hunts Future Trunks, killing Future Bulma and seemingly Future Mai as Trunks flees to the Time Capsule.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the new villain and the catastrophe that drives Trunks back to the present.

beats.label: S4 · Trunks Returns
beats.text: Future Trunks lands in the present and, mistaking Goku for Black, attacks him before Bulma calms him and he explains the future's slaughter to the group.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reintroduces Future Trunks to the cast and sets the mission to save his timeline.

beats.label: S4 · Black Follows
beats.text: Black tears a hole through time using a Supreme Kai's Time Ring and fights Goku in the present, then destroys the Time Machine before being dragged back to the future.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms Black wields Kai-level technology and strands Trunks, forcing Bulma's rebuild.

beats.label: S4 · A Familiar Energy
beats.text: Beerus and Whis note that Black's ki feels eerily familiar, and Bulma reveals she still owns Cell's old time machine to rebuild for a return trip.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the mystery of Black's identity and gives the heroes a path back to the future.

beats.label: S4 · Meeting Zamasu
beats.text: Goku, Beerus and Whis travel to the Tenth Universe and meet the apprentice Kai Zamasu, whose contempt for mortals and ki signature both mirror Black's.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the prime suspect and links Black's identity to the Kai hierarchy.

beats.label: S4 · Sparring Goku
beats.text: Goku easily outmatches Zamasu in a spar, but the humiliation only hardens the Kai's ideology that mortals are an abomination that must be erased.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows the ideology and the personal grudge that will fuel Zamasu's turn.

beats.label: S4 · Gowasu's Lesson
beats.text: Vegeta pushes Future Trunks to keep growing stronger, while Gowasu promotes Zamasu and uses a Time Ring to show him a fledgling race on Planet Babari.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts a Time Ring in Zamasu's hands and ends the season on the verge of his fall.

cliffhanger.text: Goku Black is loose across two timelines with a stolen Time Ring, and every clue points to the apprentice Kai Zamasu, who has just been handed the same power by his own master.
questions: Is Zamasu actually Goku Black, or something worse?
How did a Kai come to wear Goku's face?
Can Bulma finish the Time Machine before Black finishes the future?

characters.name: Future Trunks
characters.line: The lone survivor of a devastated timeline, now stranded in the present waiting on Bulma to rebuild a way home.

characters.name: Goku Black
characters.line: A Goku look-alike wielding a Supreme Kai's Time Ring, bent on exterminating every mortal he deems inferior.

characters.name: Zamasu
characters.line: Apprentice Kai of the Tenth Universe who despises mortals and has just been humbled in a spar by Goku.

characters.name: Gowasu
characters.line: Supreme Kai of the Tenth Universe and Zamasu's mentor, trying to teach his apprentice patience with mortal life.

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Curious about Black's familiar energy and training on King Kai's world between fights, now summoned by Zeno.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Training with Whis and pushing Future Trunks to keep striving, unsatisfied with merely matching Black.

characters.name: Bulma
characters.line: Repairing Cell's old time machine using her future self's journal so the fight can be taken back to Black.

characters.name: Beerus & Whis
characters.line: The God of Destruction and his attendant, unsettled by Black's ki and now closely watching the Kai hierarchy.

beats.label: S5 · Zeno's whim
beats.text: Bored, the two Grand Zenos agree to Goku's tournament idea. The Grand Minister announces the Tournament of Power: losing universes are erased from existence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the stakes that drive every subsequent action this season and next.

beats.label: S5 · Expo warning
beats.text: In a preview Zeno Expo, Universe 7 fights Universe 9's Trio of Danger. Buu wins, Gohan ties by poison, and Goku beats Bergamo in Super Saiyan Blue.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Signals other universes will target Goku for triggering the tournament, and shows the field's power tier.

beats.label: S5 · Top's threat
beats.text: Universe 11's Pride Trooper leader Top nearly kills Goku before the fight is stopped. Top warns that his comrade Jiren is stronger still.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants Jiren as the season's ultimate opponent without him appearing yet.

beats.label: S5 · Bulla's birth
beats.text: Vegeta refuses to leave the pregnant Bulma, so Whis warps time to bring the birth forward. Their daughter Bulla is born, freeing Vegeta to compete.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Vegeta joins the team and sets up his new family stake going in.

beats.label: S5 · Building the ten
beats.text: Goku and Gohan lock in Vegeta, Piccolo, Buu, Krillin, Master Roshi and 18. Sparring with Krillin teaches Goku the tournament is a battle royal, not duels.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the roster and the tactical lesson Goku carries into the arena.

beats.label: S5 · Rivals assemble
beats.text: Champa orders Cabba to recruit Universe 6's Saiyans, and Top gathers his Pride Troopers to enlist Jiren. Every universe now hunts Goku's team.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows the opposing teams forming, which is the shape of the tournament to come.

beats.label: S5 · Finding 17
beats.text: Dende leads Goku to Android 17, now a ranger on a wildlife reserve. Goku pitches the tournament, but 17 is unmoved even after hearing universes will be erased.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Leaves the tenth roster slot unfilled — the direct hook into the next season.

cliffhanger.text: The Tournament of Power is set and nine fighters are locked in, but Android 17 has refused to join and poachers are closing on his island. Universe 7 is still one warrior short with the clock running out.
questions: Will Android 17 change his mind and take the final slot?
How will Universe 7 stand against Jiren and the assembled universes?
What happens to the seven universes that lose?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Triggered the Tournament of Power by pitching it to bored Zenos, and is now scrambling to assemble Universe 7's ten fighters.

characters.name: The Grand Zenos
characters.line: The childlike omnipotent rulers whose boredom set the tournament in motion and whose word erases universes.
characters.note: Present and Future Zeno, side by side.

characters.name: Beerus
characters.line: Universe 7's Destroyer, furious at Goku for putting their existence on the line but forced to back the team.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Newly a father to Bulla; Whis's time-warp let him join the tournament without abandoning Bulma.

characters.name: Gohan
characters.line: Recruited as co-strategist, tied his Zeno Expo match against Lavender's poison and is helping Goku fill the roster.

characters.name: Top
characters.line: Leader of Universe 11's Pride Troopers, personally rivals Goku and is building his team around Jiren.

characters.name: Jiren
characters.line: The Pride Trooper Top calls stronger than himself; recruited off-screen, unseen in combat so far.

characters.name: Android 17
characters.line: Living quietly as a wildlife ranger with a family, has refused Goku's tournament invitation despite the stakes.

characters.name: The Grand Minister
characters.line: The Zenos' attendant who runs the tournament rules and enforces its terms on every universe.

beats.label: S6 · False Universe
beats.text: Trapped in Fu's copy of Universe Seven, Goku is attacked by Frieza and Cooler until Hearts, pulled from Hell by Demigra, offers alliance against Fu.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the setting, the rules (damage transfers to real Earth), and the enemy-of-my-enemy pact driving the season.

beats.label: S6 · Masked Saiyan
beats.text: A masked Saiyan empowers Frieza and Cooler with Dark Dragon Balls, but a cloaked Super Saiyan intervenes and steals the balls back before vanishing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces both mystery figures whose reveals drive the season's turns.

beats.label: S6 · Gather the Balls
beats.text: Hearts reveals duplicate Dragon Balls exist in this false universe, and Goku realises collecting all seven may be their only way out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's objective and explains why every faction converges on the same goal.

beats.label: S6 · Black Returns
beats.text: The masked Saiyan unmasks as Goku Black, an alternate spared before Future Zeno's erasure, who has trained by killing Gokus across ninety-nine timelines.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central antagonist reveal; the reader must know why Black is back and why he is this strong.

beats.label: S6 · Training Chamber
beats.text: Demigra's ally Shurum opens a pocket dimension so Goku and Vegeta can master Ultra Instinct and Vegeta's absorbed evil ki while the cloaked Saiyan holds Black off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains how the heroes suddenly have controlled access to their trump-card forms in the finale.

beats.label: S6 · Gogeta vs Black
beats.text: Black's mask absorbs the false universe's energy to keep healing him, until Goku and Vegeta fuse into Gogeta, reach Blue Evolved, and shatter the mask.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the immediate Black threat and shows the fusion is now the heroes' ceiling.

beats.label: S6 · Fu's Trap
beats.text: The cloaked Saiyan uses the diversion to gather all seven false Dragon Balls and activate them, teleporting Goku alone to the Universe Tree to face a younger Fu.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The cliffhanger hand-off: the cloaked ally's true purpose is unresolved, and Goku is now isolated with Fu.

cliffhanger.text: The cloaked Super Saiyan has used the finale's chaos to summon the false universe's Dragon Balls and rip Goku away from the others. He now stands alone before the Universe Tree, face to face with a younger version of Fu.
questions: Who is the cloaked Saiyan, and was helping Goku ever his real goal?
What did he wish for on the false universe's Dragon Balls?
Why is Fu suddenly younger, and what does he want with Goku at the Universe Tree?

characters.name: Goku
characters.line: Trapped in the false universe, can tap Ultra Instinct but not sustain it; just fused into Gogeta to beat Black before being teleported away alone.

characters.name: Vegeta
characters.line: Absorbed Cumber's evil ki via Turles and learned to control it in the pocket dimension; currently separated from Goku after the Dragon Ball wish.

characters.name: Goku Black
characters.line: An alternate Black who survived Future Zeno's erasure and trained across ninety-nine timelines; his mask was shattered by Gogeta and he disintegrated.

characters.name: Fu
characters.line: Architect of the false Universe Seven built from the Universe Seed; now appears in a younger form and has Goku alone at the Universe Tree.

characters.name: Hearts
characters.line: Pulled from Hell by Demigra as a temporary ally, driven by wanting Fu dead for misusing the Universe Seed; can read minds but hides what he learns.

characters.name: The Cloaked Saiyan
characters.line: An unidentified Super Saiyan who fought Black, quietly gathered all seven false Dragon Balls during the fusion battle, and activated them to pull Goku away.

characters.name: Cell
characters.line: Also retrieved from Hell in a spirit body by Demigra's faction; publicly allied with the heroes but privately vowing revenge on the Z-Fighters.

characters.name: Cumber
characters.line: The evil Saiyan whose dark ki Vegeta absorbed and turned into a new power source; currently knocked out and travelling with the group.

characters.name: Shurum
characters.line: A former Demon God working with Demigra who opened the pocket-dimension training space that let Goku and Vegeta master their forms in time for the finale.
